LESSON: GRAMMAR IN USE 1.3.1 WORD CLASSES: DETERMINERS

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: ENGLISH LANGUAGE
Strand: Strand 1
Topic 1.3: Grammar in use 1.3.1 Word Classes: Determiners

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Grammar in use 1.3.1 Word Classes: Determiners. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: How are articles used with nouns?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify definite and indefinite articles in a written text for effective communication
2. use definite and indefinite articles in sentences for effective communication

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: GRAMMAR IN USE 1.3.1 WORD CLASSES: DETERMINERS
This lesson teaches Grammar in use 1.3.1 Word Classes: Determiners for Grade 4 ENGLISH LANGUAGE.

STUDY STEPS
1. identify definite and indefinite articles in a written text for effective communication
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. use definite and indefinite articles in sentences for effective communication
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Grammar in use 1.3.1 Word Classes: Determiners using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Grammar in use 1.3.1 Word Classes: Determiners above.
2. Explain Grammar in use 1.3.1 Word Classes: Determiners to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Grammar in use 1.3.1 Word Classes: Determiners.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Grammar in use 1.3.1 Word Classes: Determiners with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Grammar in use 1.3.1 Word Classes: Determiners important for a Grade 4 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How are articles used with nouns?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify definite and indefinite articles in a written text for effective communication
2. use definite and indefinite articles in sentences for effective communication
